description: Validate a draft URL or markdown against live SERP expectations before publishing. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

device.description: Device search-result profile used for the analysis. Type: String. Accepted values: "desktop", "mobile". Default: "desktop".

draft_markdown.description: Draft page content as Markdown, used when a draft URL is unavailable; supply this or draft_url. Type: String. Minimum: 100 characters. Maximum: 50000 characters. Optional; no client default.

draft_url.description: Accessible draft or staged web page URL to evaluate; supply this or draft_markdown. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

qa_depth.description: How strict the draft quality review should be. Type: String. Accepted values: "standard", "strict". Default: "standard".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_content_draft_qa
title: AgentSEO Content Draft QA
